company.name: Nextpower Arabia
company.shortDescription: Nextpower Arabia drives solar across the (MENA) with advanced tracker systems designed to perform in desert climates and on complex terrain.
company.description: Abunayyan Holding and Nextpower have united to form Nextpower Arabia. The company is investing in advanced solar manufacturing in Saudi Arabia to support large-scale solar deployment across the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.

productsAndServices.description: An integrated platform combining solar trackers, electrical balance-of-system equipment, software, and robotics for utility-scale solar power projects.
productsAndServices.name: Integrated Utility-Scale Solar Infrastructure Platform

productsAndServices.description: Solar tracking systems that orient photovoltaic panels to improve energy capture in utility-scale projects, including installations in desert climates and complex terrain.
productsAndServices.name: Solar Trackers

productsAndServices.description: Electrical balance-of-system equipment and infrastructure used to connect, organize, and support photovoltaic modules within utility-scale solar plants.
productsAndServices.name: Electrical Balance of System (eBOS)

productsAndServices.description: Software for supporting the design, deployment, and operational management of utility-scale solar projects through connected digital systems and project data.
productsAndServices.name: Solar Software

productsAndServices.description: Robotic equipment and systems that support installation and operational activities at utility-scale solar power plants.
productsAndServices.name: Solar Robotics

productsAndServices.description: Project support from solar system design through deployment, including coordination of technical requirements for site conditions, logistics, and installation.
productsAndServices.name: Solar Project Design and Engineering Support
